you_are_here: 30 Jul evening: backend for the Mandate Record is LIVE. Sheet 24 created; script 22 deployed as a BOUND Apps Script on hand-declared narrow scopes (spreadsheets.currentonly + drive.file + script.scriptapp) after a first consent screen asking for all-of-Drive was cancelled and the cause fixed. Five tabs built, 93 pills seeded, 07:00/13:00 weight triggers installed, web app deployed. 15.3 uploaded and live-tested by Amit — reads confirmed working end to end; WRITES NOT YET TESTED. Hub still points at 15.2, repoint deliberately held. LATE CORRECTION (decision 120): Ishwa never mints a Zoho ID — Zoho IDs arrive in a datasheet that will pre-populate the mandate, and an Ishwa UID is minted alongside whatever is traced. The 17-digit creation gate shipped earlier the same evening is wrong and comes out of 15.3 and 22 next session. Documents 23 (consultant guide) and 25 (31 Jul agenda) written.

key_decisions.decision: Ishwa never mints a Zoho ID (30 Jul, decision 120)
key_decisions.rationale: Zoho IDs arrive in a datasheet that pre-populates the mandate. When one is traced, an Ishwa UID is minted alongside it; both columns already exist. No Zoho ID means an Ishwa record is created and work proceeds. Supersedes the 17-digit creation gate shipped hours earlier.

key_decisions.decision: Pill weights left flat for the demo (30 Jul, decision 118)
key_decisions.rationale: Prominence is derived from tagging, so it cannot exist before tagging. Seeding opening weights would put a guess into the column the engine later calibrates on.

key_decisions.decision: Scopes declared by hand, never inferred (30 Jul, decision 114)
key_decisions.rationale: Apps Script infers coarsely — touching DriveApp at all infers all-of-Drive. Bound script plus a hand-written oauthScopes array is the project standard for every new backend.

key_decisions.decision: Fresh-build pivot — live capture over ~6 months, no retrospective back-fill
key_decisions.rationale: Confirmed with Shalini/Somanshu 17 Jul. Six-month horizon accepted. Queue form retired.

key_decisions.decision: Training unit = candidate-level verdicts, not mandate count
key_decisions.rationale: Rejects define thresholds — the engine's 200→10 job is rejecting well.

key_decisions.decision: Containment is the project standard for all scripts
key_decisions.rationale: Multi-client account. Narrowest OAuth scopes; broad Drive grants revoked. Search Log script has zero Drive access.

key_decisions.decision: GitHub is form hosting only — never record-keeping (18 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: Deployed-state record lives in the decisions log (98) and the 00 context file. Repo sanitisation at Amit's convenience, not an action item.

key_decisions.decision: Distribution track parked behind Ishwa context call (18 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: E2E sign-off, SOP, Zoom walkthrough all pause. Pipeline itself verified working. Client-paced — no push.

key_decisions.decision: search_fingerprint + soft duplicate detection (18 Jul, rows 42-43)
key_decisions.rationale: Consultant-agnostic content key on every record. Same consultant repeat → flagged, row still written with duplicate_of (flat mapping to earliest parent). Cross-consultant identical → clean save, linked silently — convergence mined later by grouping on fingerprint. Driven by Amit's 'across 3 consultants' question.

key_decisions.decision: Filename bumps never Claude's default (18 Jul, row 37)
key_decisions.rationale: Propose, Amit decides. Same-day iterations stay inside existing filename — avoids hub/repo/URL re-sync churn.

key_decisions.decision: Verification discipline (18 Jul, row 44)
key_decisions.rationale: Behavioural claims about deployed code verified against source before stated. Lesson from duplicate-row bug.

key_decisions.decision: Slice-2 learning-layer pitch = deliberate hold, not a gap (decision 45)
key_decisions.rationale: Client ingestion lethargic; pitching an improvement layer pre-adoption compounds the 'too much' perception. Doc 21 built and quietly hosted; circulated only when Amit points to it.

key_decisions.decision: Ishwa context call held 24 Jul — distribution unparked, sourcing ownership handed to Shalini
key_decisions.rationale: Client-paced rollout; Shalini drives team adoption directly rather than Amit pushing.

key_decisions.decision: Recall redesign: client name + role title replaces UID-only recall (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: UID recall required memorising a number; client+role matches how consultants actually think about past searches, and lets a different consultant find prior work without knowing it existed.

key_decisions.decision: Commercial track opened — Shalini initiated pricing unprompted (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: First time compensation has been named by the client. Distinct track from sourcing/rubric build work.

key_decisions.decision: Columns resolved by header name, not position (29 Jul) — overrides decision 35
key_decisions.rationale: Adding, moving or renaming a column no longer needs a code change. Removes the recurring migration cost rather than paying it again each time.

key_decisions.decision: Sheet rebuilt in place, self-migrating and idempotent (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: Sheet ID constant unchanged — no re-authorisation, no 99 edit, no copy-paste of 30 JSON blobs. All rows and UIDs preserved; verified before deployment.

key_decisions.decision: Scope alone is a complete query; browse capped at 100 (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: "Show me everything I have run" is legitimate. Any criterion including a date range lifts the cap. At 50-100 searches/year the cap is only ever hit on a completely empty form.

key_decisions.decision: 7-day history dropped in favour of date filters (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: Saved on column plus Searched from/to covers the same need without a separate view. Range bounded to ten years back, no future dates.

key_decisions.decision: Label prompt fires before the write, and is optional (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: A dialog after the row is written cannot label it. Optional per Amit despite the six-month-lookback use case. Blank on every save, including re-saves.

key_decisions.decision: Client Name is mandatory, stored not prompted (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: Feeding the hiring company to the AI would nudge output toward its competitors. Client Name sits inside the fingerprint; label sits outside it.

key_decisions.decision: Company Stage split shipped as 16.3, inference parked, 16.2.2 kept as fallback (29 Jul)
key_decisions.rationale: The legacy 8-value list mixes size, lifecycle and ownership and cannot be inferred from two inputs. 16.2.2 preserves the AI logic Ishwa praises. Hub points at 16.3 only — Amit: "No one needs to know."
